statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was to evaluate the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events
The service was to correlate arrhythmic events with symptomatic giddiness
The service was denied because required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the date of service
The denial reason code is CO-197
